title.en: The space diagonal of a box

description.zh: 长方体里连接最远两个角的斜线有多长？先在底面用一次勾股定理算出底面对角线 e，再把 e 和高 c 当作新直角三角形的两条直角边用第二次，得到 d = √(a² + b² + c²)。
description.en: How long is the line joining a box’s two farthest corners? Use the Pythagorean theorem once on the base to get the base diagonal e, then again with e and the height c as the legs of a new right triangle, giving d = √(a² + b² + c²).

zh: 箱子里能放多长的棍子
en: longest stick that fits in a box

reason.zh: 底面对角线满足 e² = a² + b²，再竖起高 c，d² = e² + c²：立体问题被拆回两个平面上的直角三角形。
reason.en: The base diagonal satisfies e² = a² + b²; standing the height c on it gives d² = e² + c² — the solid problem splits back into two flat right triangles.
